hot.title: Inkling: Our Open-Weights Model
SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
hot.summary: SEED (SElf-Evolving On-Policy Distillation) enables large language model (LLM) agents to learn more effectively from their own experiences by generating and internalizing self-evolving, on-policy hindsight skills. This framework achieves substantial performance gains, such as a 14.9 to 45.9 percentage point improvement in macro-average success rate over outcome-only reinforcement learning on ALFWorld, through dense, token-level supervision and enhanced sample efficiency.

hot.title: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5: A Faster and Stronger WAM Empowered by AutoResearch
hot.summary: Researchers at GigaAI and Tsinghua University developed GigaWorld-Policy-0.5, an action-centered World Action Model designed for faster and more robust robot control. The system achieves a 0.85 success rate on fruit-picking and 0.80 on long-horizon tasks, while demonstrating a low inference latency of 85 ms on an RTX 4090, enabled by a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and optimized deployment.

hot.title: Bonsai 27B: Full 27B-Class Reasoning in Binary and Ternary Transformer Weights — On Laptops and Phones
hot.summary: PrismML introduces a post-training quantization technique that compresses a 27-billion parameter language model into binary (1.125 bpw) and ternary (1.71 bpw) formats, reducing its size to as little as 3.9 GB while preserving between 89.5% and 94.6% of its original intelligence on a comprehensive benchmark suite. This enables interactive inference on consumer laptops and high-end smartphones.

hot.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
Video = World + Event Stream
hot.summary: Wan-Streamer v0.3 introduces a "video = world + event stream" framework for general pretraining over ordinary video, enabling real-time interactive agents to perform open-vocabulary behaviors. This approach maintains a low model-side latency of approximately 200 ms for 640x368 video at 25 FPS while expanding expressive range.

hot.title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
hot.summary: The Boogu Team at Huawei Technologies and collaborating universities developed Boogu-Image-0.1, an open-source model family that integrates multimodal understanding and generation, achieving competitive performance in text-to-image tasks, image editing, and bilingual text rendering while maintaining a constrained computational budget. This was accomplished by explicitly prioritizing user intent understanding, employing syllabus-guided data curation, and optimizing inference-time strategies.

hot.title: FlowWAM: Optical Flow as a Unified Action Representation for World Action Models
hot.summary: This research introduces FlowWAM, a framework that utilizes optical flow as a unified, video-native action representation for World Action Models (WAMs). It achieves state-of-the-art success rates in robot manipulation tasks and significantly improves the reliability of action-conditioned world modeling by providing dense, cross-frame motion cues.

hot.title: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
hot.summary: This work scales zero Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to a trillion-parameter language model, demonstrating that massive computational scale can autonomously elicit advanced reasoning behaviors without human-annotated Chain-of-Thought data. It reveals a two-phase learning process and the spontaneous emergence of sophisticated cognitive strategies, including self-verification and parallel reasoning, while achieving strong performance on mathematical benchmarks and improving reasoning trace quality and efficiency.

hot.title: Inside TPU and GPU Clusters: The Anatomy of Collective Communication
Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
hot.summary: Researchers from Shanghai AI Lab and collaborating institutions systematically investigated the scaling of Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) for humanoid robots, developing a principled recipe that integrates global-frame motion tracking, a balance of data quantity and diversity, and a Humanoid Transformer architecture. This approach led to a reduction in Mean Per-Keypoint Position Error (MPKPE) on the test set by over 10% in local mode and 82% in global mode compared to prior methods.

hot.title: TRACE: Turn-level Reward Assignment via Credit Estimation for Long-Horizon Agents
hot.summary: TRACE, developed by researchers from the University of Wisconsin–Madison and Microsoft Research, introduces a critic-free credit assignment method for long-horizon agentic tasks. It enhances multi-turn tool-use performance in large language models by deriving dense, turn-level rewards from a frozen reference model's gold-answer predictability, achieving accuracy increases from 7.2% to 35.6% for Qwen3-4B and faster learning on search benchmarks.

hot.title: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable,Navigable, and Editable
hot.summary: The Harness Handbook introduces a behavior-centric representation for agent harnesses, enabling developers and coding agents to accurately locate and modify code implementations related to specific system behaviors. This approach improved edit plan quality, enhanced localization accuracy by up to 18.8 F1 points, and reduced planning token costs across diverse agent systems and modification types.

hot.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
hot.summary: NVIDIA researchers introduced RoboTTT, a framework that leverages Test-Time Training (TTT) to extend visuomotor context in robot foundation models to 8,000 timesteps while maintaining constant inference latency. This approach enables robots to achieve superior performance on complex, long-horizon tasks and unlocks capabilities such as one-shot in-context imitation and improved robustness to perturbations.

hot.title: VideoRAE: Taming Video Foundation Models for Generative Modeling via Representation Autoencoders
hot.summary: A semantic-driven video autoencoder called VideoRAE leverages frozen Video Foundation Models (VFMs) to create robust latent spaces suitable for high-fidelity video generation. This approach achieves state-of-the-art class-conditional generation, with gFVD scores of 40 (discrete) and 93 (continuous) on UCF-101, while also accelerating generative model convergence by up to five times.

hot.title: Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0: Efficient Physical-World Agents
hot.summary: Tencent Robotics X introduced Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0, an embodied foundation model designed for physical-world agents, which achieves competitive performance across 38 diagnostic benchmarks and in closed-loop navigation. Utilizing a Mixture-of-Experts architecture, it processes information with only 3 billion active parameters, improving average scores by 4.4 percentage points over the strongest comparable baseline while maintaining high efficiency.

hot.title: From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines
hot.summary: Researchers from Alaya Lab introduce a comprehensive analytical framework for interactive game world modeling, evaluating data-driven generative approaches against traditional game engine principles. The work also presents a new large-scale dataset derived from *Black Myth: Wukong*, offering over 90 hours of gameplay with frame-aligned explicit game states, actions, visual observations, and both structured and semantic annotations.

likes.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
likes.summary: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 introduces a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive world model that unifies general image/video generation with embodied synthesis, preserving foundation model generalization while adapting to robot-centric multi-view reasoning and interaction. The system achieved superior multi-view consistency and instruction following compared to existing models, and augmented data generated by it improved real-world robot policy robustness by enhancing task completion progress in interference conditions from 36.9% to 63.2%.

likes.title: AIDE²: The First Evidence of Recursive Self-Improvement
Qwen-Music Technical Report
likes.summary: Qwen-Music presents a unified framework for controllable, high-fidelity song generation that separates semantic composition from acoustic rendering to produce complete vocal singing. The model achieves competitive subjective quality against leading systems like Suno V5.5 and ranks first in 13 out of 16 objective dimensions on bilingual text-to-music benchmarks.

likes.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
likes.summary: A framework for Visual Pretraining (VP) is introduced, enabling large foundation models to learn directly from raw visual scientific documents without explicit text extraction. This approach consistently improves performance on scientific reasoning and multimodal benchmarks, fostering better cross-modal alignment while utilizing more compact data representations compared to text-only pretraining.

likes.title: Proxy Exploration and Reusable Guidance: A Modular LLM Post-Training Paradigm via Proxy-Guided Update Signals
likes.summary: A modular post-training framework for large language models, Proxy-guided Update Signal Transfer (PUST), is presented, which separates policy exploration using a lightweight proxy model from the alignment of a more capable primary model. This approach extracts and calibrates relative improvement signals for efficient transfer, yielding up to a +30.2 average performance gain for Qwen3-8B in math and +4.6 in code over base models while significantly reducing computational overhead.

likes.title: Inside TPU and GPU Clusters: The Anatomy of Collective Communication
Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
likes.summary: Li Auto Inc.'s Mach-Mind-4-Flash model, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with 3B activated parameters, attains performance comparable to or surpassing models in the 100B to 1T parameter range across diverse agentic tasks and reasoning benchmarks. This capability is achieved through an advanced post-training pipeline focused on reinforcement learning and distillation, rather than scaling pre-training compute.

likes.title: ABot-3DWorld 0: A Universal World Model to Explore Any 3D Space
likes.summary: The AMAP CV Lab of Alibaba Group developed ABot-3DWorld 0, a universal multimodal 3D world model that converts diverse inputs (text, image, video) into explorable 3D Gaussian Splatting worlds. This system unifies input processing via a Spatial Generative Primitive and achieves enhanced 3D consistency and aesthetic quality, demonstrating improved fidelity compared to existing methods on various scene categories.

likes.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
likes.summary: A comprehensive survey from Yale University and UC Irvine provides the first organized overview of metacognition in large language models. The report clarifies foundational concepts, reviews current progress in measuring and implementing these abilities, and finds that while LLMs show basic metacognitive traits, significant limitations remain, necessitating further research into dedicated methods for enhancement.

likes.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
likes.summary: Researchers introduce SpectraReward, a training-free reward model for text-to-image generation that reuses frozen multimodal large language models' (MLLMs) image-text alignment capabilities. This approach consistently improves generation performance and enables Unified Multimodal Models to self-improve, with their intrinsic understanding branch matching or exceeding much larger external reward models.

likes.title: HyperLoRA: Generating Implicit Neural Fields in Weight Space with LoRA Parameters
likes.summary: HyperLoRA transforms implicit neural fields into structured LoRA parameters, enabling semantic manipulation and efficient conditional generation of 3D and 4D content. The framework generates high-fidelity outputs comparable to existing methods, while reducing storage overhead by 99.3% compared to HyperDiffusion and demonstrating robust semantic interpolation and multimodal conditioning.

likes.title: Glob3R: Global Structure-from-Motion with 3D Foundation Models
likes.summary: The GLOB3R framework integrates 3D geometric foundation models with global Structure-from-Motion optimization to achieve robust and accurate 3D scene reconstruction. The method demonstrates superior camera pose accuracy and dense scene geometry recovery, yielding an average PSNR of 19.36 for novel-view synthesis on Tanks and Temples, outperforming COLMAP's 18.57.

likes.title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
likes.summary: VLMs often internally hold correct object count information, but their final verbalized outputs can be inaccurate due to misalignment in internal representations. Researchers developed a detector-guided self-correction method that improves VLM counting accuracy by up to 15.6 percentage points on various datasets without fine-tuning.

likes.title: Qwen-Audio-VAE Technical Report
likes.summary: Qwen-Audio-VAE, developed by the Qwen Team, introduces a continuous audio autoencoder that generates a compact 12.5 Hz latent representation while maintaining high-fidelity reconstruction across diverse audio domains. This model significantly accelerates encoding throughput by 3.62x, enabling more efficient and scalable training of downstream text-to-audio generative models.

likes.title: B-spline Policy: Accelerating Manipulation Policies via B-spline Action Representations
likes.summary: B-spline Policy (BSP) introduces a continuous action representation using B-spline curves, enabling robots to execute manipulation tasks significantly faster and with smoother motions. This method reduced task completion times by up to 50% in real-world scenarios while preserving or enhancing task success rates.
